title: Producer-supported inaccessible cycles and heldout neural legal-rule ranking / learned STOP

source.held_cycle_family_mix: 48 pairs with producer-supported 2-cycle 8<->10, 48 with producer-supported 3-cycle 8->10->13->8 at each held depth; train/dev exclusively 2-cycle
source.pairs: Exactly two one-premise source Horn rules exchange producer atom 4,5,or9 against cycle-dependent atom10; preserve all root physical known facts, role markers 6/13/14, full per-node directed degree profile and source-pair physical IDs.
source.radius2_matching: Directed physical-ID-preserving radius-two induced incidence around seven initial/role anchors must match within every pair.
source.supported_cycle: Atom 10 has at least one rule producer; every noninitial atom 4..14 has at least one producer. The mutually dependent 8/10 or 8/10/13 SCC remains unreachable in both pair members and blocks negative GOAL.
source.public_only: Model sees complete public physical incidence and current proven bits; all model-visible GraphBatch.targets zeroed. No hidden generator logical ID, split, pair, proof distance or truth.
source.disjointness: Unique encoded public physical graph hashes across every AF31 split and AF29/AF30; distinct pre-permutation logical templates across families and swap positions.
source.immutable_structure_gate: Run and certify all 384 pairs via independent bitset physical BFS and host BFS, root legal masks, root degree, radius2, exactly 2 premise changes, positive exact minimal depth and unsupported SCC with every blocked atom having a producer, before ANY train fit or scoring.

ranker.primary: AF31 trained 8-feature listwise linear physical-legal-action ranker derived from AF30 public features, 500 full-batch softmax updates, LR 0.1, L2 0.01, standardization on TRAIN only.
ranker.examples: Each TRAIN positive graph's canonical shortest physical proof trajectory: 528 distinct train labeled current states; oracle labels only TRAIN.
ranker.certificate: All _CERT arms share the same one-time public exact closure negative STOP certificate. Charge complete certificate and public graph feature work. CLOSURE/BFS are stand-alone public baselines. Never attribute certificate-based stopping to a learned model.
ranker.no_new_features: Use exactly AF30 eight public-action features and AF30 optimizer, to measure behavior under producer-supported-cycle distribution shift. Do not add explicit SCC/closure or known oracle answer as model feature.
ranker.protocol_gate: At both held depths, RANK_CERT must solve >=60/96 positives, correct negative STOP >=80/96, complete >=10/96 more positives than the strongest equal-certificate nonlearned controller (PATH, ANCESTRY, FIXED, RANDOM) and UNTRAINED, no false accepted proofs, in >=6/8 seeds.

learned_stop.label: LRANK_STOP
learned_stop.scope: Separate train-only lightweight logistic STOP gate over public root/current inference features, never exact public closure, registered no-oracle learned-only policy. Same trained ranker for legal-rule ordering.
learned_stop.features: Ten deterministic public graph/scorer summary features: min/max/mean of legal-action reverse hops, min/max/mean of blocked cost, max selected ranking score, legal rule count, known atom count, mean producer-supported root action reachability proxy; no exact closure/BFS, no label IDs.
learned_stop.fit: Train-only balanced logistic BCE, 600 full-batch steps at LR .1 and L2 .01, independently per seed; DEV-only threshold grid 0.05:0.05:0.95 with >=80/96 correct positive CONTINUE, maximize negative STOP; tie choose largest; fallback 0.95.
learned_stop.train_samples: One root per TRAIN positive/negative case (192), along with at most two train-only deterministic successor states per case; all train root labels from TRAIN BFS; DEV only 192 roots.
learned_stop.held_gate: Diagnostic success requires at each depth >=60/96 positive complete proofs, >=60/96 correct negative initial STOP and <=10/96 incorrect positive initial STOP, in >=6/8 seeds; zero false accepted proofs. Report separately, never rescue primary ranker verdict.
learned_stop.no_hidden_oracle: No split, pair index, depth, positive/negative label, global closure, independent BFS or scorer-side action budget in STOP input; proof distances used only for supervised TRAIN labels and evaluation.

frozen_direct.checkpoint_source: Original eight immutable AF23 6036-weight TypedLoop ReadoutPolicy ancestor4 checkpoints from GitHub run 43812708916, exact original ZIP SHA256 and member provenance; zero optimizer updates.
frozen_direct.gym_encoder: Use AF29 unchanged 15-atom/14-rule encoding shape with public source graph/known physical roles; all target tensors zero.
frozen_direct.compare: Use same AF31 192 held case roots at both depths, exact same host legal rule masks and shortest+1 budget. Native Direct STOP, forced continue original Direct legal ranking, and exact negative certificate + Direct rule ranking. Full-source seeds, complete episode and first off-optimal action.
frozen_direct.audit: Independent physical bitset rule-firing replay and sampled genuine Torch forward/reconstructed source score checks; preserve original checkpoint SHA provenance in receipts.

work.score_budget: Positive exact source proof length+1 firings; negative 2 decisions. The budget is scorer-only.
work.report: Complete saved per-case trajectories, 2-cycle/3-cycle family, swapped j position, per-seed paired counts, violations, action errors, symbolically charged rule exams, model-node evaluations, CPU wall-clock, no claimed shared FLOP scale.

verdicts.engineering: Source-only mismatch or missing frozen-model checkpoints is INCONCLUSIVE; all verified evaluated seed failures are scientific FAIL.
verdicts.amendment: Any change before scored data must be dated prereg amendment. After first held scoring, preserve that registered verdict and establish new experiment for source/threshold changes.
verdicts.base: Preserve all AF22–AF30 scientific verdicts; new branch from draft AF30, keep AF30 unmerged.
